title: n8n binary files go missing between nodes in queue mode or after upgrading to 2.0
symptoms: A worker cannot read a binary file written by another process in queue mode
N8N_AVAILABLE_BINARY_DATA_MODES no longer has any effect
Disk use grows after 2.0 where binary data used to stay in memory
cause: Filesystem binary storage is local to one machine, so it does not work across queue mode workers. In 2.0 the in-memory default mode was removed, leaving filesystem for regular mode, database for queue mode, and s3.
fix: In queue mode use database or S3 binary storage, and in regular mode budget disk for the filesystem default.
apply:
EXECUTIONS_MODE=queue
N8N_DEFAULT_BINARY_DATA_MODE=database   # or s3 with external storage configured
affected: Self-hosted n8n queue mode, all versions; default-mode removal in n8n 2.0
